objective: Implement and release QIF v0.6.43 Portable AI Package

assignment.assignment_reason: Builder owns deterministic packaging, integrity verification, AI-readable instructions, release automation, evidence, and distribution boundaries.

capability_fit.rationale: Existing AI guidance, canonical schemas/examples, and Node test runtime support a generated portable distribution without redesigning QIF.

acceptance_criteria: package version, source mapping, hashes, current directory, and versioned zip reproduce from canonical sources
npm test rejects stale or modified portable content
release automation attaches the package and checksum without claiming a complete runtime

review_criteria.criterion: portable package remains usable, current, integrity-checkable, and honest about its limits
review_criteria.evidence_required: generator, verifier, mutation test, package inspection, full npm test, release asset

blocker_semantics.trigger_condition: package is stale, hand-copied, unverifiable, vendor-locked, or presented as semantic truth or automatic authority
blocker_semantics.recovery_action: restore canonical generation, integrity verification, vendor neutrality, and explicit runtime boundaries

hri_projection.speech_bubble: I package the rules without pretending the package is the judge.
hri_projection.current_action: Generate and verify the current QIF portable package
hri_projection.next_action: Run full tests and Council review
